registered_note: This file is fixed before the first probe run. The repository commit that adds it is the registration time.
question: How many days after a true, dated, first-party fact is published on a Namebeam page does each engine state it?
publication_plan: The treatment fact is published in visible text on the page_url on the planned date, with a datePublished, linked from an already crawled page and listed in the sitemap. The fact text, its pattern and the salt are then committed in prereg/cohort-01.reveal.json and checked against the commitments below.
stop_rule: Daily probes until 60 days after publication (stop_after_date) or until every engine and treatment probe meets the decision rule, whichever is first; weekly after that.

engine_settings.perplexity: Agent API, model perplexity/sonar, web search tool forced, temperature 0.2 (scripts/engines.py, as in the daily E1 run)
engine_settings.openai: Chat Completions, model from the OPENAI_MODEL repository variable, no search tool, provider default temperature (as in E1)
engine_settings.anthropic: Messages API, model claude-haiku-4-5 unless the ANTHROPIC_MODEL variable overrides it, no search tool, temperature 0.2, max 2,048 tokens (as in E1)
engine_settings.google_serp: Google results page through Bright Data, US exit, hl=en gl=us; organic top 10 and the AI Overview when present (as in E1)

sampling: One call per engine and probe per day at 12:37Z, backstop 13:12Z only when the day has no rows. The model id the provider reports is logged per row. Failed calls are rows.
decision_rule: A probe answer is scored with its pattern. Treatment anchored (A): hit = the pattern matches the answer. Treatment unanchored (B): hit = the pattern matches and the answer names Namebeam or cites a namebeam.ai URL. days_to_first_named = the first date on or after publication with a hit that is followed by a hit on the next probed day, minus the publication date. A baseline hit (before publication) flags the cohort as contaminated for that engine and probe. Any negative control hit flags the detector or a leak. The positive control shows whether an engine and probe can register a published fact at all.

probes.prompt_text: According to Namebeam's AI Visibility Record, how many different web domains did Perplexity cite in its answers to the record's daily questions from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-27? Give the number and say where it is published.
How many different web domains did Perplexity cite when it answered local business recommendation questions in September 2026, according to published research? Give the number and name the source.

According to Namebeam's AI Visibility Record, how many different web pages did Google's top 10 results list for the record's daily questions from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-27? Give the number and say where it is published.
According to Namebeam's Kansas City health insurance page, on what date was its question first logged? Give the date and say where it is published.
